finding: Libya and Algeria rank last on volume
verdict: Robust to all five variants, but partly artefactual
basis: Stable under every robustness variant, but the Libya search cell is the smallest AND worst-retrieved, and francophone Algerian work is invisible to an English search
No country ranks first under all variants; Tunisia falls to 2nd and 3rd under two of them
Libya ranks 2nd of 5 per million people; only the area and raw denominators put it last

finding: Full-text access is unequal by country
basis: Mechanical retrieval outcome, no model judgement involved

finding: Three a priori conflict taxa have zero studies
verdict: Real gap, with the language caveat
basis: African wolf, crested porcupine and fennec fox were written into the search string before retrieval and actively searched for; the search sought them and found nothing. All three are terrestrial, which is where francophone coverage bites hardest

finding: Livestock depredation has one study region-wide
basis: Jackal, wolf and hyaena predation is a live regional issue; one study across five countries is not a plausible complete picture, and the francophone qualifier applies with full force
The non-English term blocks were far narrower and the Latin binomials sat in an English-filtered cell; this is a search-construction fact, not a fact about the literature
